summary: Instrumental music from text with ACE-Step 1.5 (XL SFT audio model + 4B planner), one track per seed, 48 kHz stereo FLAC, optional loop candidate.

model.license: Check the ACE-Step repository and each model card for commercial-use terms before shipping outputs.

tested: 2026-10-22, Colab A100 40 GB: 5 x 180 s tracks, 97 s each after about 6 min setup (install 175 s, download 100 s, load 76 s); 1.49 units. Peak PyTorch memory 21.8 GiB, so L4 is not offered.
setup_summary: clone ACE-Step 1.5 at its pinned commit; uv sync --python 3.12 from its lock
run_summary: download the three pinned model revisions, load both models once, one track per cue and seed, keep the FLAC original, optionally an overlap-crossfade loop WAV and a wrap audition, write receipt.json
